question: What supreme Eye of the two Śivas is being honored in this invocation?
premises: The Eye is described as illumination in nature
It belongs to the two Śivas and is supreme
inference: We bow to that supreme Eye of the two Śivas, whose nature is illumination and which holds all powers
uncertainties: The identity of the two Śivas is not specified in this verse
plain_english: We bow to that supreme Eye of the two Śivas, whose nature is illumination and which possesses all powers.
